types.name: Domain
types.description: An ENS domain name

fields.name: id
fields.description: Domain identifier (name or namehash)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full domain name (e.g., 'vitalik.eth')

fields.name: labelName
fields.description: Label only (e.g., 'vitalik' for 'vitalik.eth')

fields.name: labelhash
fields.description: Keccak256 hash of the label

fields.name: parent
fields.description: Parent domain

fields.name: subdomains
fields.description: Subdomains of this domain

fields.name: resolvedAddress
fields.description: Address this domain resolves to

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Current owner of the domain

fields.name: resolver
fields.description: Resolver contract for this domain

fields.name: ttl
fields.description: ENS V1 Registry TTL (from `NewTTL` event). Null when never set or for V2 domains.

fields.name: isLegacy
fields.description: V1-only provenance: true when the row's most recent update came from the legacy pre-2020 ENS Registry (0x314159…); false when it's been touched by the canonical post-2020 Registry (0x00…2e1e) or for V2 names.

fields.name: isMigrated
fields.description: Whether this domain has been migrated to V2

fields.name: isWrapped
fields.description: Whether this name is currently wrapped in V1 NameWrapper. When true, the `owner` field returns the wrapped-token owner (EOA), NOT the NameWrapper contract address — this is a deliberate divergence from the ENS subgraph for client convenience. Subgraph clients that need the NameWrapper-as-owner shape should query the on-chain `ownerOf()` directly.

fields.name: fuses
fields.description: Fuse bitmap from V1 NameWrapper (CANNOT_UNWRAP, PARENT_CANNOT_CONTROL, etc.). Null when not wrapped.

fields.name: wrapperExpiry
fields.description: Wrapper expiry timestamp from V1 NameWrapper. Null when not wrapped.

fields.name: gracePeriodEnd
fields.description: Grace-period end for V1 .eth 2LDs (expiry + 90 days). Now an explicit-name alias for `Domain.expiryDate` (which itself includes the grace period for V1 .eth 2LDs per subgraph parity). Null for non-V1 names, non-.eth 2LDs, or names without expiry.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: ENS protocol version this domain belongs to ("v1" = legacy ENS, "v2" = ENSv2).

fields.name: isReachable
fields.description:
Whether this domain is reachable via canonical top-down resolution.
  False when an ancestor label's subregistry pointer has moved away from
  the subregistry contract that originally minted this domain (orphaned
  subtree), when the domain has been LabelUnregistered, or when an
  ancestor expiry has passed. Default GraphQL queries filter
  `isReachable: true` — pass `where: { includeUnreachable: true }` to
  include orphans.

fields.name: unreachableSince
fields.description: Timestamp when this domain first became unreachable (null while reachable)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when domain was created

fields.name: registrationDate
fields.description: Timestamp when domain was registered

fields.name: registrant
fields.description: Original registrant of the domain

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Timestamp when domain expires. For V1 .eth 2LDs, includes the 90-day grace period (`BaseRegistrar.expires + 90d`) to match subgraph semantics. The bare on-chain `expires` is still available via the parallel `Registration.expiryDate`.

fields.name: tokenId
fields.description: ERC-721 token ID for this domain

fields.name: canonicalId
fields.description: Canonical token ID (without version bits)

fields.name: tokenVersion
fields.description: Token version number

fields.name: normalizedName
fields.description: ENSIP-15 normalized name (null if normalization fails)

fields.name: isNormalized
fields.description: Whether the name passes ENSIP-15 normalization (computed at query time)

fields.name: events
fields.description: Events associated with this domain

fields.name: subdomainsCount
fields.description: Count of direct subdomains (one level only). Filtered by `isReachable = 1` AND excluding fully-burned names (owner=0 AND resolver=0, mirroring subgraph's GC deletion criteria). DEPRECATED: prefer `subdomainCount` (subgraph-compatible name).

fields.name: subdomainCount
fields.description: Subgraph-compatible alias for `subdomainsCount`. Returns the same value.

fields.name: eventsCount
fields.description: Count of events associated with this domain

fields.name: wrappedDomain
fields.description: V1 NameWrapper wrapped-domain record. Null for V2 or unwrapped domains.

fields.name: wrappedOwner
fields.description: Wrapped owner (V1 NameWrapper EOA). Null when not wrapped.

types.name: Account
types.description: An Ethereum account (address)

fields.name: id
fields.description: Ethereum address

fields.name: domains
fields.description: Domains owned by this account

fields.name: registrations
fields.description: Registrations made by this account

fields.name: primaryName
fields.description: Reverse-resolved primary name for this address (V1 ReverseRegistrar + NameChanged path). Null if not claimed.

fields.name: wrappedDomains
fields.description: V1 NameWrapper wrapped-domain records owned by this account.

fields.name: seenV1
fields.description: True if this address has ever been observed acting under the V1 protocol (owner, registrant, role grantee, transfer recipient, or operator).

fields.name: seenV2
fields.description: True if this address has ever been observed acting under the V2 protocol.

fields.name: firstSeenBlock
fields.description: Block number of the earliest observation across protocols. Zero if the account row was populated by backfill (no first-observation block was recorded).

fields.name: firstSeenTimestamp
fields.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the earliest observation across protocols. Zero if unknown.

types.name: AccountFilter

inputFields.name: seenV1
inputFields.description: Restrict to addresses observed under V1 (true) or never observed under V1 (false).

inputFields.name: seenV2
inputFields.description: Restrict to addresses observed under V2 (true) or never observed under V2 (false).

types.name: Account_orderBy
types.description: Sort key for the `accounts` query.

enumValues.name: firstSeenBlock
enumValues.description: First-observation block (the earlier of V1/V2 observations).

types.name: ResolverFilter
types.description:
Filter input for the `resolvers` (entity-list) query (subgraph parity).
Fields combine with AND semantics. Use `address`/`address_in` to scope by
resolver contract, `namehash` to scope by name, and `protocol` (`"v1"` or
`"v2"`) for protocol isolation.

inputFields.name: address
inputFields.description: Exact match on resolver contract address (0x-hex, lowercase).

inputFields.name: address_in
inputFields.description: Resolver contract address in list (up to 1000).

inputFields.name: namehash
inputFields.description: Exact match on the bound name's namehash.

inputFields.name: protocol
inputFields.description: Restrict to a single protocol — `"v1"` or `"v2"`.

types.name: Resolver_orderBy
types.description: Sort key for the `resolvers` (entity-list) query.

enumValues.name: address
enumValues.description: Lexicographic order on the resolver contract address.

enumValues.name: setBlock
enumValues.description: First-binding block (when this resolver was first bound to this name).

types.name: CoinAddress
types.description: A coin address record with coin type (SLIP-44)

fields.name: coinType
fields.description: SLIP-44 coin type (e.g., 60 for ETH, 0 for BTC, 501 for SOL). DEPRECATED: prefer `coinTypeBig` — ENSIP-11 L2 coin types (0x80000000 | chainId) exceed Int32 and will overflow. Kept for back-compat.

fields.name: coinTypeBig
fields.description: Decimal-string coin type. Use this instead of `coinType` to safely represent ENSIP-11 L2 coin types that exceed Int32.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Address value for this coin type

types.name: Pubkey
types.description: A public key record (secp256k1 coordinates)

fields.name: x
fields.description: X coordinate (hex string)

fields.name: y
fields.description: Y coordinate (hex string)

types.name: InterfaceRecord
types.description: An interface implementation record

fields.name: interfaceId
fields.description: Interface ID (EIP-165 selector, hex string)

fields.name: implementer
fields.description: Implementer contract address

types.name: Alias
types.description: A resolver alias mapping (from OwnedResolver)

fields.name: fromName
fields.description: Source DNS name

fields.name: toName
fields.description: Destination DNS name

types.name: Resolver
types.description: A resolver contract for an ENS domain

fields.name: id
fields.description: Resolver contract address

fields.name: address
fields.description: Resolver contract address (same as id)

fields.name: addr
fields.description: Address record for a specific coin type (default: 60 for ETH)

fields.name: addresses
fields.description: All set addresses across all coin types

fields.name: coinTypes
fields.description: All coin types currently set on this resolver/name as decimal strings (ENSIP-11-safe). Parallel projection of `addresses.coinTypeBig`.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Canonical Domain associated with this resolver (first by namehash). Null when this resolver isn't bound to any name. Subgraph parity.

fields.name: contentHash
fields.description: Content hash (IPFS, Arweave, etc.)

fields.name: texts
fields.description:
All text-record keys set on this resolver/name. This is a list of scalar
  strings (the keys only), NOT a list of {key, value} entities — the ENS
  subgraph's `texts` field has the same name but a different shape, so a
  subgraph-style `texts { key value }` selection will fail. To read values,
  call `text(key: "...")` per key.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Get a specific text record value by key (returns null if unset).

fields.name: pubkey
fields.description: Public key record (secp256k1 x/y coordinates)

fields.name: abis
fields.description:
ABI content types set on this resolver. List of scalar integers (the
  contentType bitmasks only), not a list of entities — `abis { ... }` with
  a subselection will fail.

fields.name: reverseName
fields.description: Reverse name record (from NameChanged events)

fields.name: interfaces
fields.description: Interface implementations set on this resolver

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Aliases set on this resolver (from AliasChanged events)

fields.name: version
fields.description: Current version counter (from VersionChanged events)

types.name: Registration
types.description: A domain registration record

fields.name: id
fields.description: Registration identifier

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the registered domain

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain that was registered

fields.name: registrationDate
fields.description: Timestamp when domain was registered

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Timestamp when domain expires

fields.name: registrant
fields.description: Account that registered the domain

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Chain where registration occurred (v1 or v2)

fields.name: cost
fields.description: Total user-paid registration cost (base + premium) in wei, decimal-encoded. Returned as String because u256 wei values exceed GraphQL Int (Int32). Null when the Controller event has not been observed for this registration.

fields.name: baseCost
fields.description: Base rent cost in wei, decimal-encoded u256 (String for the same Int32 reason as `cost`). Null when the Controller event has not been observed.

fields.name: premium
fields.description: Auction premium portion in wei, decimal-encoded u256 (String, see `cost`). \"0\" for legacy 5-arg LegacyEthRegistrarController (no auction-premium semantics) or null when the Controller event has not been observed.

fields.name: labelName
fields.description: Human-readable label from the Controller event preimage (e.g., 'vitalik'). Null when the Controller event has not been observed or the label preimage was lost.

fields.name: referrer
fields.description: Referrer bytes32 hex from the 7-arg UnwrappedEthRegistrarController (V1) or V2 ETHRegistrar.NameRegistered. Null for older Controller variants or when no Controller event has been observed.

types.name: TransferData
types.description: Typed payload for `Transfer` events. Spans V1 BaseRegistrar ERC721 (`tokenId` numeric), V1 NameWrapper ERC1155 (`id` is the wrapped namehash, with `operator`/`value`), and V2 registry transfers.

fields.name: from
fields.description: Sender address.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Recipient address.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Token id: ERC721 tokenId as a decimal string, or wrapper/V2 token id (namehash for NameWrapper). Stringified to preserve u256 range.

fields.name: value
fields.description: ERC1155 transfer amount (always 1 for ENS NameWrapper).

fields.name: operator
fields.description: ERC1155 operator address (V1 NameWrapper / V2 only).

types.name: NameRegisteredData
types.description: Typed payload for `NameRegistered` events (V1 BaseRegistrar + ETHController variants).

fields.name: name

fields.name: label

fields.name: owner

fields.name: expires

fields.name: baseCost
fields.description: Base price paid for the name, in wei (decimal string).

fields.name: premium
fields.description: Premium component for premium-priced names (decimal string).

fields.name: cost
fields.description: Total cost = baseCost + premium (decimal string).

fields.name: referrer
fields.description: Referrer bytes32 (from the 7-arg UnwrappedEthRegistrarController variant).
